analysis.subject: civics
analysis.pageCoverage: Page covers the electoral college timeline from election day through certificates of ascertainment, state meetings of electors, transfer and counting of votes in Congress, inauguration, and rules for objections and contingent election by the House and Senate.

overview.headline: From election day to inauguration, how electors are appointed and votes counted

keyPoints.point: Students learn the District of Columbia is allocated three electors under the 23rd Amendment.
keyPoints.quote: Under the 23rd Amendment of the Constitution, the District of Columbia is allocated three electors and treated like a State for purposes of the Electoral College.

keyPoints.point: Students learn the state executive prepares seven certificates of ascertainment after certification.
keyPoints.quote: Your State's Executive prepares seven Certificates of Ascertainment.

keyPoints.point: Students learn electors meet in their states to cast separate ballots for president and vice president.
keyPoints.quote: The electors meet in their respective States and vote for President and Vice President on separate ballots.

keyPoints.point: Students learn Congress meets in joint session to count electoral votes and announce results.
keyPoints.quote: Congress meets in joint session to count the electoral votes.

keyTerms.gloss: individuals chosen to cast separate ballots for president
keyTerms.quote: The electors meet in their respective States and vote for President and Vice President on separate ballots.

keyTerms.gloss: documents the executive prepares to record appointed electors
keyTerms.quote: Your State's Executive prepares seven Certificates of Ascertainment.

keyTerms.gloss: forms electors use to record votes for president
keyTerms.quote: The electors record their votes on six Certificates of Vote, which are paired with the six remaining Certificates of Ascertainment.

keyTerms.gloss: general election results reflecting votes cast by citizens
keyTerms.quote: The States use these general election results (also known as the popular vote) to appoint their electors.

keyTerms.gloss: combined meeting of congress to count electoral votes
keyTerms.quote: Congress meets in joint session to count the electoral votes.
